project_id_policy: generated UUID bound to the selected state root
client_id_policy: engine-issued connection UUID; not a claim of native task attestation
task_id_policy: stable user-work identity within a project
plan_revision_policy: monotonic integer; one current revision per project
delta_id_policy: stable identity for revised work; new identity for replaced outcomes
release_identity_policy: source commit plus package content digest; deployment metadata is separate
retired_public_aliases: none registered; legacy names are absent from the v4 action registry
